findings.evidence: src/app/plans/[planId]/AddItemForm.tsx (an enumerated codeFile for this doc) implements toCents() with regex /^(\d+)(\.(\d{1,2}))?$/; when the entered amount does not match, onSubmit sets err to "Amount must be a number with max 2 decimals (e.g. 1200 or 1200.50)" and returns before calling fetch - i.e. a genuine client-side rejection branch that never reaches the POST /api/plans/{planId}/items route handler.
findings.locationHint: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] No alternative (non-error) flows were evidenced in the grounded code; the handler has a single linear success path.
findings.message: The Alternative Flows section claims no alternative/error flows were evidenced, but the codeFiles for this doc include AddItemForm.tsx, whose toCents() client-side validation rejects malformed amount input (blocking submission with an inline error) before any request is sent - this evidenced flow is absent from both Alternative Flows and Error Handling.
